notice: Operational policy for the manual V1. It is not an enforcement boundary.

required_when: tests written by the same model that wrote the code
user or A1 marks the patch high-risk
independent_review.deny_means: not review-complete; no integration or push; local checkpoint allowed

degraded.trigger: review is required but cannot be performed
degraded.label: degraded-not-independent
degraded.after: store packet, notes, and checkpoint in tasks/<task>/review-packets; priority 1 on user return
